name: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
timing_instruction: Fasted upon waking (07:00 - 08:30) for SIRT1 and NAMPT circadian peak
target_pathway: Cellular NAD+ biosynthesis, DNA repair via PARP1
key_warning: Take with Methylated Folate/B12 (TMG) to prevent methyl pool depletion

name: Magnesium Glycinate
optimal_form: Bisglycinate chelate (avoids laxative effect of oxide)
target_pathway: GABA-A receptor agonism, NMDA receptor blockade, muscle relaxation
key_warning: Never co-administer with Calcium or high-dose Zinc

name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
timing_instruction: Consume with the highest-fat meal of the day (12:30 - 13:30)
optimal_form: Liquid softgels suspended in olive or MCT oil
target_pathway: Nuclear VDR transcription, immune modulation, genomic bone mineral regulation
key_warning: Mandatory co-administration with Vitamin K2 (MK-7) to direct calcium into bones instead of arteries

name: Vitamin K2 (Menaquinone-7 / MK-7)
timing_instruction: With midday meal alongside Vitamin D3 and dietary fats
target_pathway: Carboxylation of Osteocalcin and Matrix Gla Protein (MGP)
key_warning: Contraindicated with Warfarin / Coumadin vitamin K antagonists

name: Omega-3 (EPA / DHA)
timing_instruction: With meals to prevent lipid oxidation and fishy reflux
optimal_form: Re-esterified Triglyceride (rTG) form (70% higher bioavailability than ethyl esters)
target_pathway: Cell membrane fluidity, resolvins and protectins anti-inflammatory cascade
key_warning: High doses (>3g) exert anti-platelet blood thinning effects

name: Ashwagandha (KSM-66 / Sensoril)
timing_instruction: Early evening (18:00 - 19:30). Must cycle 6 weeks on, 2 weeks off
key_warning: Do not take continuously without washout intervals; risk of liver enzyme spike and emotional blunting

name: L-Theanine
timing_instruction: Morning with caffeine (1:2 ratio) or bedtime for slow-wave sleep promotion
target_pathway: Glutamate receptor antagonism, cortical alpha-wave generation
key_warning: Extremely safe with high therapeutic index

name: Berberine HCl
optimal_form: Dihydroberberine or Phytosome (5x higher intestinal absorption)
target_pathway: Mitochondrial Complex I mild inhibition, AMPK phosphorylation, GLUT4 translocation
key_warning: Do not combine with Metformin; inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6

name: Creatine Monohydrate
timing_instruction: Consistent daily dose (5g) with carbohydrate/protein shake for insulin-mediated muscle uptake
target_pathway: Phosphocreatine shuttle, rapid cellular ATP resynthesis in brain and skeletal muscle
key_warning: Raises serum creatinine harmlessly (does not reflect true kidney injury; verify via Cystatin-C)

name: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound)
timing_instruction: Fasted 250mcg - 500mcg (Oral arginate salt for gut; SubQ for systemic tendon repair)
target_pathway: VEGF upregulation, FAK-paxillin angiogenesis pathway, eNOS stimulation
key_warning: High theoretical angiogenesis rate; avoid in active malignancy

name: Zinc (Picolinate / Bisglycinate)
timing_instruction: With light food (15-30mg) to prevent gastric mucosal nausea
target_pathway: Thymulin activation, testosterone synthesis, superoxide dismutase (SOD)
key_warning: Doses >30mg/day must be balanced with 2mg Copper to prevent neutropenia

name: Semaglutide / Tirzepatide (GLP-1/GIP)
timing_instruction: Subcutaneous injection once weekly on fixed schedule
target_pathway: Central appetite suppression, delayed gastric emptying, beta-cell insulin secretion
key_warning: Delay all oral capsule absorption; hydrate aggressively to prevent acute renal injury
